## What do you want

Describe it in the words a player would use, not in the words the code uses.

## Which milestone does it belong to

[docs/milestones.md](../../docs/milestones.md) holds the build order. The
project is at M0 of seven, so most mechanics belong to a milestone that has
not started.

Naming the milestone is not a formality. A request that needs accounts cannot
land before M3, and saying so stops the request being closed as premature when
it is only early.

- [ ] It fits a milestone that has started
- [ ] It belongs to a later milestone
- [ ] I am not sure

## Does it interrupt the turn order

Nothing acts outside the turn order today. That is what makes the forecast a
promise rather than a guess, and both players read that forecast.

If your idea lets something act out of order, say so plainly. It is not
refused, but it costs the forecast its accuracy, and that is a real price.

- [ ] It acts only on a character's own turn
- [ ] It acts outside the turn order
- [ ] I am not sure

## Does it need a new stat

Six stats exist: HP, attack, defence, magic attack, magic defence, and speed.
Crit and status stats are deliberately absent, because nothing reads them yet.

If your idea needs a seventh, say which and why the six do not do it.

## Are you arguing against a decision

This is welcome, and it is more useful than a feature request.

[docs/milestones.md](../../docs/milestones.md) records six places this project
left its own specification behind, each with the reason. Name the reason you
think is wrong, and say why.
